title: The Smudged Class Roll
story: Tuesday is school night again in Thimble Harbor, this time for grown-ups, with evening classes until nine. Mabel, who now teaches the grammar class, keeps the roll for the whole building. Four new students each signed up for one class and wrote an age on the form, in a pencil that has since smudged, and Mabel does not accept a smudged roll. Who is taking which class, and how old is each?

texts: The student taking guitar is exactly 15 years older than the student taking watercolor.

trace.text: Clue 1 means Jade cannot be age 55 and Felix cannot be age 40.
Since Felix can still be only age 45, age 50, or age 55, clue 2 means Felix cannot be age 55 and Hugo cannot be age 40 or age 45.
Since Jade can still be only age 40, age 45, or age 50 and Felix can still be only age 45 or age 50, clue 1 means Jade cannot be age 50.
Since Jade can still be only age 40 or age 45, clue 3 means Una cannot be age 45, age 50, or age 55 and Jade cannot be age 40.
Jade must go with age 45: clue 3 rules out age 40; clue 1 rules out age 50 and age 55.
Felix must go with age 50: clue 1 rules out age 40; clue 2 rules out age 55; age 45 already goes with Jade.
Hugo must go with age 55: clue 2 rules out age 40 and age 45; age 50 already goes with Felix.
Una must go with age 40: clue 3 rules out age 45, age 50, and age 55.
Clue 4 means the guitar class cannot be age 40, age 45, or age 50 and the watercolor class cannot be age 45, age 50, or age 55.
The watercolor class must go with age 40: clue 4 rules out age 45, age 50, and age 55.
The guitar class must go with age 55: clue 4 rules out age 40, age 45, and age 50.
The Spanish class must go with age 50: age 45 is already ruled out for Jade; the other choices are already taken.
The pottery class must go with age 45: the other choices are already taken.
Jade goes with age 45, so Jade also goes with the pottery class.
Felix goes with age 50, so Felix also goes with the Spanish class.
Hugo must go with the guitar class: the watercolor class is already ruled out for age 55; the other choices are already taken.
Una must go with the watercolor class: the other choices are already taken.
